{{short description|German mathematician}}
[[File:Stephan Luckhaus.jpg|thumb|220px|Luckhaus at [[Oberwolfach]], 2009]]
'''Stephan Luckhaus''' is a German mathematician who is a professor at the [[University of Leipzig]] working in pure and applied analysis.<ref name="manw">[http://www.math.uni-leipzig.de/MANW/6_0/en_luckhaus.html Faculty profile], retrieved 2011-05-06.</ref> His PhD was obtained in 1978 under the supervision of [[Willi Jäger]] at the [[University of Heidelberg]].<ref>{{mathgenealogy|id=23506}}</ref> He was elected to the [[German Academy of Sciences Leopoldina]] in 2007.<ref name="manw"/>
